entities.summary: Georges Thierry d'Argenlieu, in religion Father Louis of the Trinity, OCD, was a Discalced Carmelite friar and priest, who was also a diplomat and French Navy officer and admiral; he became a major personality of the Forces navales françaises libres. He was the chancellor of the Ordre de la Libération.
